source.source_title: iPod nano (3rd generation) - Technical Specifications - Apple Support (IE)
source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification page archived as original HTML on 2026-11-11; 13 source sections extracted. The first record section preserves model-identification evidence from Apple's separate identification page.
notes: Technical specifications are transcribed from the model-specific Apple technical-specification page; each added section carries its own source URL and archive path.
Model-identification evidence remains available from https://support.apple.com/en-ie/103823, archived at apple_remaining_extraction/technical_specs_html/ipod-index.html.

extraction.note: Official Apple iPod identification text retained. Explicit model numbers, introduction dates, capacity options and navigation interface extracted where present with source-section provenance. These are identification-page records, not full historical technical-specification sheets; no absent specs inferred.

sections.heading: iPod nano (3rd generation)
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Click Wheel
Capacity: 4 and 8 GB
Model number and date introduced: A1236: September 2007
You can distinguish the iPod nano (3rd generation) from previous iPod nano models by:
Its wider screen
Hold switch is on the bottom
Its ability to play video
The last three characters of the serial number will be one of these: YOP, YOR, YXR, YXT, YXV or YXX.
The iPod nano (3rd generation) comes in five colours.

sections.heading: Size and weight
sections.source_text: Height: 2.75 inches (69.8 mm) Width: 2.06 inches (52.3 mm) Depth: 0.26 inch (6.5 mm) Weight: 1.74 ounces (49.2 grams)

sections.heading: In the box
sections.source_text: iPod nano Earphones USB 2.0 cable Dock adapter Quick Start guide

sections.heading: Capacity
sections.source_text: 4GB or 8GB flash drive 1 Holds up to 1,000 or 2,000 songs in 128-Kbps AAC format 2 Holds up to 3,500 or 7,000 iPod-viewable photos 3 Holds up to 4 hours (4GB) or up to 8 hours (8GB) of video 4 Stores data via USB flash drive

sections.heading: Display
sections.source_text: 2-inch (diagonal) liquid crystal display with blue-white LED backlight 320-by-240-pixel resolution at 204 pixels per inch

sections.heading: Audio
sections.source_text: Skip-free playback Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz Audio formats supported: AAC (16 to 320 Kbps), Protected AAC (from iTunes Store), MP3 (16 to 320 Kbps), MP3 VBR, Audible (formats 2, 3, and 4), Apple Lossless, AIFF, and WAV User-configurable maximum volume limit

sections.heading: Video
sections.source_text: H.264 video, up to 1.5 Mbps, 640 by 480 pixels, 30 frames per second, Low-Complexity version of the H.264 Baseline Profile with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats; H.264 video, up to 2.5 Mbps, 640 by 480 pixels, 30 frames per second, Baseline Profile up to Level 3.0 with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats; MPEG-4 video, up to 2.5 Mbps, 640 by 480 pixels, 30 frames per second, Simple Profile with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats

sections.heading: Headphones
sections.source_text: Earphones Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz Impedance: 32 ohms

sections.heading: Mac system requirements
sections.source_text: Mac computer with USB 2.0 port Mac OS X v10.4.8 or later iTunes 7.4 or later 5

sections.heading: Windows system requirements
sections.source_text: PC with USB 2.0 port Windows Vista or Windows XP Home or Professional with Service Pack 2 or later iTunes 7.4 or later 5

sections.heading: Languages
sections.source_text: Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, and Turkish Additional language support for display of song, album, and artist information: Bulgarian, Croatian, Romanian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, and Ukrainian

sections.heading: Environmental requirements
sections.source_text: Operating temperature: 32° to 95° F (0° to 35° C) Nonoperating temperature: -4° to 113° F (-20° to 45° C) Relative humidity: 5% to 95% noncondensing Maximum operating altitude: 10,000 feet (3000 m)

sections.heading: Power and battery 6
sections.source_text: Built-in rechargeable lithium ion battery Playback time Music playback time: Up to 24 hours when fully charged Video playback time: Up to 5 hours when fully charged Charging via USB to computer system or power adapter (sold separately) Fast-charge time: about 1.5 hours (charges up to 80% of battery capacity) Full-charge time: about 3 hours

sections.heading: Connectivity
sections.source_text: USB through dock connector; component and composite video through dock connector (with AV cables or kit, sold separately); audio through headphone jack
